'''Onrein Hasar''' was an ambitious [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who felt an intense hatred for [[Suljo Warde]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who took [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She founded the [[Whitescar Syndicate]]<ref name="CotG" />
